scripts.text: They were sucking people like us dry!

scripts.text: Isn't it a good thing that we sought revenge on Suad and secured the necessary supplies?

scripts.text: Exactly!! You suffered a lot because of your father. You came here because of him.

scripts.text: Simply because you're indigenous, he not only refused to acknowledge you as a capable son but also subjected you to abuse. In fact, he probably never even acknowledged you as his son.
scripts.translation: 就因為你是原住民，他不但不承認你是個有本事的兒子，還虐待你。說不定他根本沒把你當兒子看過。

scripts.text: Aisha? Why are you here? Did you come to return the wolf?
scripts.translation: 艾莎？你怎麼來了？是來送狼崽回去的嗎？

scripts.text: No, it's not like that. You brought the wolf... with you? In front of the sheep? Are you out of your mind?
scripts.translation: 不對，不是那樣。你把狼帶來了？還帶到羊群面前？你瘋了嗎？

scripts.text: Why on earth are you trying to raise a wolf? Do you need a dog? Then get a dog.
scripts.translation: 你幹嘛非要養狼？想養狗的話就養狗啊。不如我來當

scripts.text: No, I'll just become the dog. I'll mess up your house too and occasionally bite you.
scripts.translation: 狗好了，我會把你家弄得亂七八糟，還會時不時咬你。

scripts.text: Scania, I heard your wishes loud and clear. So, did you even send a person to me? Are you treating me like some kind of a contractor, adventurer?
scripts.translation: 斯堪尼亞，你的話我都聽見了。你甚至派人來找我？你把我當成什麼委託人了嗎，冒險者？

scripts.text: Despite all your efforts, so what? This person has already sided with me! Hahaha! Come on, show me that face of despair!
scripts.translation: 你費盡心思又怎麼樣？這位已經站在我這邊了！哈哈哈！來，讓我看看你絕望的表情！

scripts.text: What? Adventurer? You betrayed me? How could you do that? Betrayal at first sight, isn't that too much? I should have known. Outsiders like you can't be trusted.
scripts.translation: 什麼？冒險者，你背叛我了？怎麼能這樣？剛見面就背叛，也太過分了吧！我早該知道，外人根本不可信。

scripts.text: Scania, have you ever been to the Ice Caves? Is the blood flowing in your veins colder than the frozen water there? You cold-blooded one!
scripts.translation: 斯堪尼亞，你去過冰洞嗎？你血管裡的血比那裡的冰水還冷嗎？你這個冷血的傢伙！

scripts.text: How can you even suggest sending this small and fragile little creature back to such a dangerous place? Its mother is dead, and it can't survive on its own.
scripts.translation: 你怎麼能把這麼弱小的孩子送回那麼危險的地方？它的母親已經死了，它自己活不下去。

scripts.text: I said that, didn't I? I told you a hundred times. You didn't listen again, did you? You just believe what you want to believe, right?
scripts.translation: 我不是說過了嗎？都告訴你一百遍了，你又沒聽吧？你只相信自己想相信的，對不對？

scripts.text: I don't know about you, but I can't bear to send this small and fragile young wolf back to the market.
scripts.translation: 你怎麼想我不管，但我不忍心把這麼弱小的幼狼送回去。

scripts.text: But if that wolf grows up, our sheep...
scripts.translation: 可是等狼長大了，我們的羊......

scripts.text: Oh, do I need to talk about it?
You won't listen to me anyway. You never listen to me when I talk, and you only believe what other people say.
scripts.translation: 反正你也不會聽我的。我說的話你從來不聽，只相信別人說的。

scripts.text: This wolf cub will be fine if it is trained. If it grows up with other friends from a young age, it will not harm them and will instead protect the sheep.
scripts.translation: 只要好好訓練，這隻狼崽就不會有事。從小和夥伴們一起長大的話，它不會傷害大家，反而會保護羊群。

scripts.text: Did you hear me? Where is your refutation? Come on, smart genius! Sit down! Hands up!
scripts.translation: 聽見了嗎？怎麼不反駁？來啊，聰明的大天才！坐下！舉手！

scripts.text: It's true. But... but I don't know how long it will last... I don't know if it will be able to suppress its wild nature...
scripts.translation: 你說得沒錯。可是......我不知道能堅持多久，也不知道它能不能壓住野性......

scripts.text: But most of all, I don't think you'll be able to train it that patiently.
scripts.translation: 而且，我不覺得你能那麼有耐心地訓練它。

scripts.text: I'll help you with any nervousness so you can be fully trained. I'll take him for walks so we can bond.
scripts.translation: 我會幫忙緩解你的顧慮，讓它接受充分訓練。我也會帶它散步，和它培養感情。

scripts.text: You said it was hard to keep chasing after the cub when he went for walks alone. Isn't this a good thing?
scripts.translation: 你不是說它自己散步時很難追上嗎？這樣不是正好嗎？

scripts.text: Are you sure you can take care of our wolf cub? I'm worried about him being outside with all the dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation: 你確定能照顧好我們的狼崽嗎？外面魔物那麼危險，我很擔心它。

scripts.text: See those calluses on your hands, Adventurer? You said Maram brought him here, so he must be trustworthy. He's a veteran we trained in minutes!
scripts.translation: 冒險者，看看你手上的繭！既然瑪拉姆把他帶來，肯定信得過。他可是我們幾分鐘就訓練出來的老兵！

scripts.text: Oh, well... I can't help coming all the way here, so can I ask you a favor? Hehe.
scripts.translation: 哎呀......既然你都特地跑來了，能不能幫我一個忙？呵呵。

scripts.text: You're so excited, like you've been waiting for this moment. Aren't you taking it too cold?
scripts.translation: 你興奮得好像盼這一天很久了。是不是對這件事太冷淡了？

scripts.text: Oh no~ You're so~ desperately~ asking!! So, I can't help but...
scripts.translation: 哎呀～你這麼～拼命地～請求我！！那我也只能......

scripts.text: Anyway... I need to talk to the villagers about the cub. Our little one is safe! Let's go, little cub!
scripts.translation: 總之......我得去和村民們談談狼崽的事。小傢伙已經安全了！走吧！

scripts.text: Oh... suddenly became a temporary shepherd, huh...? Thank you. I had a lot to do. What can I do to help?
scripts.translation: 哦......突然就成了臨時牧羊人啊......？謝謝你，我還有好多事要忙。該怎麼幫你呢？

scripts.text: Ah, right! Outsiders often like these sorts of things. Do you like it, adventurer? Even if you don't, you can exchange it for something you like with someone who does. Take it with you.
scripts.translation: 啊，對了！外地人好像都喜歡這種東西。冒險者，你喜歡嗎？不喜歡的話，也能拿去和喜歡的人交換。收下吧。

scripts.text: Sure, see you on our walk then.
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
scripts.translation: 灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
Please wait the end of the quest delay.
scripts.translation: 請等任務冷卻時間結束。

scripts.text: Adventurer, you've worked hard. I think our dog is also satisfied. Did you have a good meal time? Then, please try again tomorrow!
scripts.translation: 冒險者，辛苦了。我想小狗也很滿足。用餐時間愉快嗎？那明天再來吧！灰

scripts.text: ^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
scripts.translation: 狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。你有 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
There are a few places the dog likes, and I will guide you. You only need to deal with dangerous monsters nearby.
scripts.translation: 小狗喜歡幾個地方，我帶你去。你只要處理附近危險的魔物就行。

scripts.text: It's a pain in the ass because ashrings rush in. Please take care of the surrounding ashrings. I usually catch 20 eagles a day. Then please.
scripts.translation: 灰燼靈不斷衝過來，真煩人。幫忙處理附近的灰燼靈吧。我平時一天能抓二十隻鷹。拜託了。

scripts.text: Adventurer, I came on time for our walk. But Aisha didn't show up...
scripts.translation: 冒險者，我準時來散步了，可艾莎沒來......

scripts.text: Sure, I'll take you for a walk. Really... do I have to go too? Can I trust you to handle it?
scripts.translation: 好吧，我帶你去散步。真是的......我也得去嗎？交給你一個人行不行？

scripts.text: Ah... I see... You're busy. Well, then there's nothing to be done about it.
scripts.translation: 啊......這樣啊......你有事要忙，那也沒辦法。

scripts.text: Oh, come on, look at my disappointed face. There's nothing I can do. Today, come with me. Well then, goodbye, adventurer!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，看看我這失望的表情！沒辦法，今天就跟我來吧。再見啦，冒險者！

scripts.text: If you're worried, you can come along.
scripts.translation: 要是擔心的話，你也可以一起來。

scripts.text: h, no. Alright then, I'll leave it to you. Take care, pup. If you're worried or don't like it, let me know and come home. Got it?
scripts.translation: 啊，不......好吧，那就交給你了。小傢伙，要小心。要是不放心或不喜歡，就告訴我，回家來，知道嗎？

scripts.text: I'll guide you to a few places that the pup likes. He can find and eat on his own, so just take care of any nearby dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation: 我帶你去幾個小傢伙喜歡的地方。它會自己找東西吃，你只要處理附近危險的魔物就行。

scripts.text: Ashlings keep swarming and causing headaches... Please take care of the nearby Ashlings. We usually end up catching about 20 of them per day. So, I'd appreciate your help with that.
scripts.translation: 灰燼靈總是成群湧來，真讓人頭疼......幫忙處理附近的灰燼靈吧。我們平時一天大約會抓二十隻，拜託了。

scripts.text: I'll guide you to a few places that the pup likes. Just take care of any nearby dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation: 我帶你去幾個小傢伙喜歡的地方。你只要處理附近危險的魔物就行。

scripts.text: Ashlings keep swarming and causing headaches... Please take care of the nearby Ashlings. We usually end up catching about 20 of them per day. So, I'd appreciate your help with that.
scripts.translation: 灰燼靈總是成群湧來，真讓人頭疼......幫忙處理附近的灰燼靈吧。我們平時一天大約會抓二十隻，拜託了。

scripts.text: We need to show Scania that our Boksil is safe and reliable!
scripts.translation: 得讓斯堪尼亞知道，我們家福實很安全、很可靠！

scripts.text: Do you want to see wolf cub poop? How cute is it? Oh, but don't touch it.
scripts.translation: 想看狼崽拉便便嗎？多可愛呀！不過別碰哦。

scripts.text: Boksil~ Let's live together forever with me. If someone comes to harm you, I will personally bury them in the Oz Maze. So don't worry, Wolf Cub~ Just trust me and let's live happily.
scripts.translation: 福實～以後永遠和我在一起吧。誰敢傷害你，我就親手把他埋在歐茲迷宮裡。所以別擔心，小狼崽～相信我，我們會幸福地生活下去。

scripts.text: No, Boksil. Calm down a bit. Oh dear. What will happen if you still act unfamiliar? No, I'm not saying anything to you... Let's get closer, shall we?
scripts.translation: 不，福實，冷靜一點。哎呀，你還是這麼認生可怎麼辦？不，我不是在說你......我們再親近一點，好嗎？

scripts.text: I understand, I understand. You need some time alone. Honestly, I feel the same way. In the end, we're all alone in this world. So let's live well on our own while still living together.
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道。你想一個人待會兒。說實話，我也一樣。畢竟這世上終究只能靠自己。所以我們就各自過好生活，同時住在一起吧。

scripts.text: Why? What did I do...... Huh? Who are you? I've never seen you before.
scripts.translation: 為什麼？我做錯什麼了......咦？你是誰？我好像沒見過你。

scripts.text: So this is the wolf cub?
Don't get too close to my wolf cub. Put your hands down. Turn around and disappear.
scripts.translation: 別靠近我的狼崽。把手放下，轉身離開。

scripts.text: I don't call anyone a bad people. Anyone who tells me to abandon my wolf cub is a villain. And I show no mercy to villains.
scripts.translation: 我不會隨便說誰是壞人。但凡叫我拋棄狼崽的人都是惡人，我絕不會對惡人手下留情。

scripts.text: How long have you been here?
I can't disclose that as it's personal information. Why do you ask?
scripts.translation: 這是個人隱私，我不能告訴你。你為什麼問？

scripts.text: No, this wolf cub, I don't think he's trained yet.
scripts.translation: 不，這隻狼崽好像還沒受過訓練。

scripts.text: ... No, that's. She's about a month old now. There's no way she can train while she's still a baby.
scripts.translation: ......不是那樣的。她才一個月大，還是幼崽，怎麼可能接受訓練呢？

scripts.text: What? I knew it! Get at least 10 paces away from my wolf cub right now. Don't come any closer.
scripts.translation: 什麼？我就知道！馬上離我的狼崽至少十步遠，不準再靠近。

scripts.text: I am not here to take her, I am here to check on here... If she separated from the pack, we have to put them back, and we have to be prepared for the mother wolf to come looking for them.
scripts.translation: 我不是來帶走她的，只是想看看情況......如果她和狼群走散了，就得把她送回去，還得提防狼媽媽找來。

scripts.text: She's not stray out of the pack, she was picked up next to next to its dying mother wolf.
scripts.translation: 她不是和狼群走散的，是在垂死的狼媽媽身邊被發現的。

scripts.text: Oops. It's probably nervous about being separated from his mother and living in a strange place.
scripts.translation: 哎呀。她和媽媽分開，又到了陌生的地方，可能因此很不安。

scripts.text: Are you sure you're not here to take her away, then why are you here?
scripts.translation: 既然你不是來帶走她的，那你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: I did come to persuade after confirming whether it was indeed a wolf cub...
scripts.translation: 我確實是先來確認她是不是狼崽，然後才打算勸你的......

scripts.text: I knew it! Sent by Scania, right? Why are you meddling with other people's pets? Our wolf cub isn't dangerous, so go back. There's nothing more to see.
scripts.translation: 我就知道！是斯堪尼亞派你來的吧？為什麼要管別人的寵物？福實一點也不危險，回去吧，沒什麼好看的。

scripts.text: As long as you're careful, there's nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation: 只要小心一點，就不用擔心。

scripts.text: Do you really think so? Do you really think our wolf cub could be a potential threat? Look at how small and cute she is...
scripts.translation: 你真這麼覺得？你真的認為我們的狼崽可能有危險嗎？看看她，多小多可愛......

scripts.text: You might have thought so under normal circumstances, but... if she doesn't have a mother, at least there wouldn't be any reason for wolves to come here.
scripts.translation: 換作平時你或許會這麼想......不過，如果她沒有母親，狼群至少就沒有理由找來了。

scripts.text: I understand what you're saying! But stupid Scania doesn't know that! Even a complete stranger like you understands my heart so well!
scripts.translation: 我明白你的意思！可愚蠢的斯堪尼亞不懂！連你這個陌生人都這麼理解我的心情！

scripts.text: Moreover, this motherless wolf cub wouldn't be able to survive on its own.
scripts.translation: 而且，這隻失去母親的狼崽也沒法獨自活下去。

scripts.text: That's right! That cold-hearted one has turned ice-cold right down to the head.
scripts.translation: 沒錯！那個冷血的傢伙簡直從頭到腳都凍成冰了。

scripts.text: However, for Boksil to live in the village, she needs training. She must learn how to interact with others without causing harm and how to get along.
scripts.translation: 不過，想讓福實留在村裡，就得訓練她。要教她如何與大家相處、避免傷人。

scripts.text: It should be done when she's young. If we start training it from a young age, there won't be any of the concerns the villagers have.
scripts.translation: 就該趁她還小的時候開始訓練。這樣村民們擔心的問題就不會發生了。

scripts.text: Firm tone, immediate response, and sufficient praise will be enough for it to understand well. Wolves are smart, you know. What does wolf cub like the most?
scripts.translation: 只要語氣堅定、及時回應，再多給些鼓勵，她就能聽懂。狼很聰明的。狼崽最喜歡什麼？

scripts.text: Hm... Meat? But there isn't any right now. Do adventurers have some?
scripts.translation: 嗯......肉？可是現在沒有。冒險者，你有帶嗎？

scripts.text: Oh...! There's no meat to give as a snack, meat... I need to bring some meat.
scripts.translation: 啊......得拿肉當零食喂她才行。我得去準備些肉。

scripts.text: How are you supposed to train with meat? You only need one?
scripts.translation: 用肉怎麼訓練？只要一塊就夠了嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, don't touch our Boksil! She doesn't like it!
Didn't you say you needed a chunk of meat? is not it?
scripts.translation: 你不是說要一塊肉嗎？對吧？

scripts.text: Hello~ I am {0}. Your name is Boksil, right? Nice to meet you. Are you feeling anxious in this unfamiliar place? I know exactly how you feel, I know everything about you.
scripts.translation: 你好～我是。你叫福實，對吧？很高興認識你。在陌生的地方是不是有點不安？我懂你的感受，我什麼都知道。 {0}

scripts.text: But it's okay. Everything's fine. There's no one here who would harm our Boksil. Don't worry.
scripts.translation: 沒事，一切都好。這裡沒人會傷害福實，放心吧。

scripts.text: Now we're all living together. With a warm shelter and delicious food to eat.
scripts.translation: 現在大家住在一起，有溫暖的窩，也有好吃的東西。接

scripts.text: Then we need to establish some rules. Okay?
scripts.translation: 下來我們得定些規矩，好嗎？

scripts.text: I feel like I'm talking to a child.
scripts.translation: 感覺像是在跟小孩子說話。

scripts.text: Here, look. Meat. Does Boksil like meat? Grilled, raw, or boiled? You've never tried grilled? That's okay, you'll have plenty of opportunities to try it in the future.
scripts.translation: 看，是肉。福實喜歡吃肉嗎？烤的、生的還是煮的？沒吃過烤肉？沒關係，以後有的是機會嘗。

scripts.text: Well done. Here is your meat.
Did you see? If she follows instructions like this, please give her a lot of praise.
scripts.translation: 看到了嗎？她這樣聽從指令時，要好好表揚她。

scripts.text: Mom, Mom. Isn't our child a real genius?
scripts.translation: 媽媽，媽媽！我們的孩子是不是天才

scripts.text: Our Boksil did a great job!!!!
We need to keep doing this until she gets used to it. Repetitive training is important. Just keep doing it like you're doing now.
scripts.translation: 要一直練到她習慣為止。重複訓練很重要，像剛才那樣繼續就好。

scripts.text: Training these kinds of domestic animals varies. Making them feel secure in this place and building a good bond with them will help them settle in well.
scripts.translation: 訓練這類家畜各有方法。讓她在這裡感到安心，並和她建立良好的關係，會幫助她適應環境。

scripts.text: And if they also interact with other friends and spend time together from a young age, they should get along well without any major issues.
scripts.translation: 如果她從小就和其他夥伴相處、一起生活，應該也能融洽相處，不會出什麼大問題。

scripts.text: You just need to show them what you've done. It shows that Boksil is ready to live as a member of this village.
scripts.translation: 你只要把成果展示給大家看就行。這能證明福實已經準備好成為村裡的一員。

scripts.text: Let's go back to <NAVI>[Scania]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and show off our wonderful and majestic Boksil.
scripts.translation: 我們回<NAVI>[斯堪尼亞]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧，讓大家看看可愛又威風的福實。

scripts.text: Boksil is cute. But we're going to <NAVI>[Scania]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> right? Don't forget.
scripts.translation: 福實很可愛。不過我們要去<NAVI>[斯堪尼亞]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧？別忘了。

scripts.text: Why are you eavesdropping on other people's conversations?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼偷聽別人說話？

scripts.text: Uh, once again at the village meeting, all they did was talk nonsense, that old man.
scripts.translation: 唉，今天村民會議上那個老頭又在胡說八道。

scripts.text: That old man? Ah, the one whose name cannot be mentioned?
scripts.translation: 那個老頭？啊，就是不能提名字的那位？

scripts.text: I mean, I can't mention it.
I heard he was someone important in Rahel, said to have some influence in the Gray Wolf Forest.
scripts.translation: 字嘛。我聽說他以前是拉赫的重要人物，在灰狼森林也頗有影響力。

scripts.text: That old man, whether it's Ahap or Ahab!
scripts.translation: 那個老頭，到底叫阿哈普還是阿

scripts.text: He doesn't act like that when he's in Rachel~ He must have messed up~
scripts.translation: 哈布！他在拉赫時可不是這副樣子～一定是搞砸了～

scripts.text: If that's the case, why bother coming here instead of staying in Rachel?
scripts.translation: 既然這樣，幹嘛不待在拉赫，非要跑來這

scripts.text: Does she still not realize she's in Rachel?
scripts.translation: 她還沒發現自己在拉赫嗎？

How may I help you, outsider?

scripts.text: Now that the waterways are well-maintained, it's not in such high demand~
scripts.translation: 的～現在水道維護得不錯，需求沒那麼大

scripts.text: I'm only making a small amount~
The ingredients are hard to find~
I need it in a few days, so I can't buy it in bulk~
scripts.translation: 我幾天後就要用，所以沒法大量

scripts.text: But~ there's only so much water you can purify in a single use~
scripts.translation: 購買～而且～每次能淨化的水量也有限～

scripts.text: If you run out of water on the way to your destination, and you have a suitable hydration station, you can use the item~
scripts.translation: 如果去目的地的路上缺水，只要附近有合適的取水處，就能用這個淨化水

scripts.text: But you have to boil the water once~
scripts.translation: 不過，水還得煮沸一次～有

scripts.text: May the goddess Freyja bless you~
May the goddess Freyja bless you.
It is a holy relic for the essence of today's fish~
scripts.translation: 這是今天漁獲的聖物～趁

scripts.text: Hurry up before it's sold out~
Ah, the last time you went to the top, didn't you?
scripts.translation: 啊，你上次說要去上面來著？

scripts.text: You came back sooner than expected. It seems that business is going well~
scripts.translation: 這麼快就回來了，看來事情辦得挺順利～

scripts.text: Today's holy water purification relic has just been released~
scripts.translation: 今日份的聖水淨化聖物剛剛上架

scripts.text: Just one in front of each person. Now, come quickly~
I thought it was relatively clean water, but when I put a holy object in it, it glowed brightly and gave me a somewhat sacred feeling.
scripts.translation: 我以為這水已經挺乾淨了，可把聖物放進去後，它突然發出耀眼的光，給人一種神聖的感覺。光

scripts.text: As the light subsides, the water looks clean.
scripts.translation: 芒消散後，水看起來乾淨多了。

scripts.text: I'll put it in a bucket and take it to Budan.
scripts.translation: 我把水裝進桶裡，帶給布丹。

scripts.text: This is a water container for drinking water used throughout the village.
scripts.translation: 這是全村共用的飲用水槽。一側裝著幹

scripts.text: One side contains clean water, the other relatively clean water.
scripts.translation: 淨水，另一側裝著比較乾淨的水。

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt doesn't seem to have been properly reinforced yet. The material hasn't disappeared, so let's keep trying^000000

scripts.text: That was terrible. Don't touch a sword again
Why did you abandon the carriage and come this far??
scripts.translation: 你為什麼丟下馬車跑到這裡來了？

scripts.text: Isn't it just an accident? Apologizing might be unnecessary....
scripts.translation: 這只是場意外吧？或許沒必要道歉......

scripts.text: You're being too harsh on the trade manager.
scripts.translation: 你對貿易管理員太苛刻了。

scripts.text: I'm not going to argue with you anymore. Just do what you think is best..
scripts.translation: 我不想再和你爭了。你覺得該怎麼辦就怎麼辦吧。

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt seems like you're not in a state to listen to the conversation properly.^000000
scripts.translation: 你現在似乎沒法好好聽人說話。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: I can't have made the wrong choice in coming here...?
scripts.translation: 我來到這裡，應該沒有選錯吧......？

scripts.text: We can get most things here, but not steel. I'd like to ask for a small favor. Just 3...
scripts.translation: 這裡大部分東西都買得到，唯獨沒有鋼材。我想請你幫個小忙，只要3塊......

scripts.text: Steel!! Steel, when will it come! ... oh it's here. You're here, Adventurer. It's heavy, isn't it? Give it to me. I can't let you hold it for another second, you're a precious person. Thank you. You've done a good job.
scripts.translation: 鋼材！！鋼材什麼時候才到！......啊，送來了。冒險者，你來了。很重吧？快給我，我不能讓你再多拿一秒，你可是貴客。謝謝你，辛苦了。

scripts.text: When the clinic is completed, we'll engrave your name on the foundation stone so that your name will live on in the lives of future newborns.
scripts.translation: 診所建成後，我會把你的名字刻在奠基石上，讓未來的新生兒也記住你。

scripts.text: Although time passes and the building disappears, the adventurer's will will remain forever.
scripts.translation: 即使歲月流逝，建築終會消失，冒險者的心意卻會永遠留下。

scripts.text: With this steel, I'll now build a clinic that would withstand any kind of weather, and will stand up to any elements.
scripts.translation: 有了這些鋼材，我就能建一座堅固的診所，讓它經受住各種天氣和自然環境的考驗。

scripts.text: Are you saying you're going to build a Clinic? Now?
What do you mean by Calm down? We're having an ice-cold, rational conversation. Now!
scripts.translation: 冷靜什麼？我們現在正在進行一場冷靜、理性的談話！

scripts.text: Why are you doing this? Are you being territorial about the newcomers?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要阻止我？是因為排斥新來的人嗎？

scripts.text: Oh my, we're not those kind of people.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我們可不是那種人。

scripts.text: Then why are you so opposed to it?
The comfortable life you want is a trap. Something foreign, something comfortable. Those things will ruin us.
scripts.translation: 你想要的舒適生活就是陷阱。外來的東西、舒適的東西，都會毀了我們。

scripts.text: Comfortable housing, thriving schools, clean clinics. Why shouldn't we have them? We've avoided discrimination, not convenience.
scripts.translation: 舒適的房子、興旺的學校、乾淨的診所，我們為什麼不能擁有？我們拒絕的是歧視，不是便利。

scripts.text: I live here anyway, what's the harm in having better facilities?
scripts.translation: 反正我也住在這裡，改善設施又有什麼壞處？

scripts.text: No, I guess that's what the newcomers want?
scripts.translation: 不，這些大概就是新來的人想要的吧？

scripts.text: Accustoming your body to comfort makes an uncomfortable life unbearable. Live with satisfaction within the minimum life they provide.
scripts.translation: 習慣了舒適，就會受不了艱苦的生活。只要在他們給的最低限度生活裡知足就行。聽說你

scripts.text: They say that if you protest, they will take this away too.
scripts.translation: 們一抗議，他們連這點東西也會收走。

scripts.text: How long do you think we're going to live here, never mind take our land back!
scripts.translation: 更別說奪回土地了，你覺得我們還要在這裡住多久？

scripts.text: What you have now is enough, what more do you need?
scripts.translation: 你現在有的已經夠多了，還想要什麼？

scripts.text: I'm not doing this because I'm ungrateful. They say that they are not bringing it here because this it's too foreign for them. Technology and facilities have developed over time, but you just don't understand it!
scripts.translation: 我不是不知感恩。他們說這些東西對他們來說太陌生，所以不願帶到這裡來。技術和設施一直在進步，可你就是不明白！

scripts.text: Oh my, I think I'm dying. Help...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我好像快不行了。救命......

scripts.text: Maram? What is it? What happened?
scripts.translation: 瑪拉姆？怎麼了，發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: If I die... put my accumulated wealth...! With me. Did you get it?! It's unfair! Maram, make sure you guard my grave well! Don't let a single penny be stolen!
scripts.translation: 我要是死了......就把我攢下的財富......都埋進墳墓裡。聽見沒？！太不公平了！瑪拉姆，好好守住我的墳墓！一分錢也別讓人偷走！

scripts.text: No, you won't die. Don't be ominous.
scripts.translation: 不會死的，別說這種不吉利的話。

scripts.text: There's been an accident while moving the luggage. I need to get it taken care of quickly. Can you do that, Ezekiel?
scripts.translation: 搬執行李時出了事故，得趕緊處理。以西結，你能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: Oh my, how come? I can't use one leg at all and I'm still fine.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，怎麼會這樣？我一條腿都不能動了，不也還好好的嗎？

scripts.text: Let's move it to my house quickly. I may not be able to use my legs, but I need to at least apply some medicine to prevent them from rotting.
scripts.translation: 快把他抬到我家去。我腿腳不方便，但至少能給他上點藥，免得傷口惡化。

scripts.text: Do I have to cut my legs off like Mr. White Pine over here? I can't do that... I just bought a new pair of work boots...!
scripts.translation: 我也得像那邊的白松先生一樣把腿砍掉嗎？我可做不到......我才買了雙新工作靴啊！

scripts.text: Are your boots a problem now?
scripts.translation: 這時候還惦記你的靴子？

scripts.text: ... That's right, Maram. I have a favor to ask. Can you find someone who is missing a left leg but has a healthy right leg? I guess I'll have to sell him my right boot.
scripts.translation: ......是啊，瑪拉姆，我想拜託你一件事。能不能找個左腿不方便、右腿還健全的人？我把右靴賣給他好了。先

scripts.text: Sir, please make this as smooth as possible.
scripts.translation: 生，麻煩你儘量處理得順利些。

scripts.text: I'm not going to cutting your leg off, I can heal it.
scripts.translation: 我不會砍你的腿，我能治好它。

scripts.text: What? With a leg that is shaped like that?
scripts.translation: 什麼？那條腿都變成那樣了？

scripts.text: How do you fix a leg like that...! Let's cut it off and put some medicine on it to stop it from getting infected! Don't waste time by holding it...!
scripts.translation: 那種腿怎麼治得好......！趕緊砍掉，再上藥防止感染！別抱著它浪費時間了......！

scripts.text: I'm saying I can do it because I can do it. Everybody, get out of the way.
scripts.translation: 我說能治就能治。大家讓開。

scripts.text: You'll have to trust him. Ezekiel may not look like much in your eyes, but he's pretty good, right?
scripts.translation: 你得相信他。以西結看起來也許不怎麼樣，但本事很不錯，對吧？

scripts.text: Ahhh... If only we had the right equipment... I could have done it faster... I can't help it.
scripts.translation: 啊......要是有合適的器材，我就能更快治好......沒辦法了。

scripts.text: Adventurer, how's it going, can I start my construction?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，情況怎麼樣？我能開始建造了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm trying to keep it out of the way so it doesn't affect anything else, but I guess that doesn't work either.
scripts.translation: 我試著把工程安排在不妨礙其他人的地方，可看來還是不行。

scripts.text: But I can't give up, and I'm glad you're willing to come back and talk about it, but before then, I need to get a group of like-minded people together and get ready to convince them.
scripts.translation: 但我不能放棄。很高興你願意回來談這件事，不過在那之前，我得先召集一些志同道合的人，準備好說服大家。

scripts.text: I thought about doing what they said, but I can't. I don't know what else to do, but this is something I need to do.
scripts.translation: 我想過照他們說的做，可我辦不到。我也不知道還能怎麼辦，但這件事我必須做。

scripts.text: Speaking of which, Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.
scripts.translation: 對了，冒險者，我有件事想請你幫忙。

scripts.text: You can get most things here, but not Steel. Because of how difficult it is to bring it in, not to mention you need a lot of facilities to make Steel. So, Would it be okay if you bring me 3 of them? just 3...
scripts.translation: 這裡大部分東西都買得到，唯獨沒有鋼材。運輸鋼材很困難，製造它又需要很多裝置。能幫我帶三塊來嗎？只要三塊......

scripts.text: Thank you for your generosity. I'm glad you're so sympathetic to my cause and willing to help... I'll go get ready for construction.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你願意幫忙。我很感激你理解我的想法......我先去準備建造的事。

scripts.text: Please convince <NAVI>[sir]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>that we need this facility.
scripts.translation: 請說服<NAVI>[那位先生]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，讓他明白我們需要這項設施。

scripts.text: Ezekiel, you didn't come here to live a life of riches. You came here to do a job!
scripts.translation: 以西結，你來這裡不是為了過富裕的生活，而是來完成工作的！

scripts.text: No, but to live here as myself is to really live. I am an eternal stranger here, am I not?
scripts.translation: 不，在這裡做自己才算真正活著。可我永遠是這裡的外人，不是嗎？

scripts.text: Shhh- wait a minute, listen to what he's saying, he sounds like he's saying something.
scripts.translation: 噓，等一下，聽聽他說什麼。他好像有話要說。

scripts.text: No, but I'm just as much an outsider here as I am there. Isn't that the same? Shouldn't I be more comfortable?
scripts.translation: 不，我在這裡和在那邊一樣，都是個局外人。這不都一樣嗎？我不是應該過得自在些

scripts.text: Maybe I should just give up and go home.
scripts.translation: 嗎？也許我該放棄，回家算了。

scripts.text: No, but that's what I initially aimed for. Finding my roots...
scripts.translation: 不，可這正是我最初想做的事......尋找自己的根......

scripts.text: Ezekiel! How have you been? Why are you muttering to yourself like that?
scripts.translation: 以西結！最近怎麼樣？你怎麼一個人在這兒自言自語？

scripts.text: Maram? Maram?? That's great. You know what, listen to me. You're busy? You're busy, but listen. Who am I going to tell this to? I don't even know anybody yet. So listen to me.
scripts.translation: 瑪拉姆？瑪拉姆？太好了！聽我說。你很忙？我知道你忙，可還是聽我說吧。我還能跟誰說呢？我還不認識什麼人。先聽我說......

scripts.text: I told you I was going to build a clinic here. When I came here, there was no decent clinic, so I build one.
scripts.translation: 我說過要在這裡建一所診所。我剛來時，這裡連像樣的診所都沒有，所以我就打算建一所。

scripts.text: That's right. That's why I got a lot of things to fill it with this time.
scripts.translation: 是啊，所以這次我帶了很多東西來添置裝置。

scripts.text: I did that, but as soon as I started digging, the elders here stopped me. They say we should live in harmony with nature as we have done up until now, but they look at me as some sort of environmental destroyer. Am I that kind of person?
scripts.translation: 可我剛開始挖，長老們就來阻止。他們說應該像過去那樣與自然和諧共處，卻把我當成破壞環境的人。我真是那種人嗎？

scripts.text: Is it really that destructive to nature and the environment to just build a more hygienic, more modern clinic, which would allow for a faster response in an emergency?
scripts.translation: 只為了建一座更衛生、更現代、能在緊急情況下及時救治病人的診所，就會對自然和環境造成那麼大破壞嗎？

scripts.text: No. You aren't that kind of person. Everyone else, but never you.
scripts.translation: 不會。你不是那種人。別人或許是，但你絕不是。

scripts.text: Isn't that right? And you've gotten me to the point where... I'm not doing anything right now because I'm thinking, Am I really a bad person?
scripts.translation: 對吧？可現在我卻開始懷疑自己是不是壞人，什麼也做不了......

scripts.text: If that's the case, you should talk to Suad. That's not fair. We're all trying to live together. The clinic isn't against nature. Oh, come on.
scripts.translation: 既然這樣，就該去找蘇阿德談談。這不公平，大家都在努力一起生活。診所並不違背自然。唉......

scripts.text: Well... I talked to Suad... but he said there was nothing he could do and that he couldn't do what he wanted either.
scripts.translation: 我和蘇阿德談過了......他說他無能為力，也不能隨心所欲地做事。

scripts.text: I told him that we need a clinic, but we can't just push it through because the elderly people who have lived here for a long time are against it, so we have to convince them.
scripts.translation: 我告訴他我們需要診所，可不能強行推進，因為在這裡生活多年的長者們反對，所以得先說服他們。

scripts.text: From the sounds of it, so does he. We can't ignore the opinions of the elders, after all, and it's not like Suad's the kind of guy who'd bend over backwards to do so.
scripts.translation: 聽起來他也這麼想。畢竟不能無視長者們的意見，蘇阿德也不是會強行做這件事的人。

scripts.text: So... I'm... going back to Rachel... What do you think?
scripts.translation: 所以......我......準備回拉赫了......你覺得呢？

scripts.text: What, you came this far and you're going back?
scripts.translation: 什麼？都走到這一步了，你還要回去？

scripts.text: No, I didn't set out to go back... It's just that people are like that, they come here to have a better life, and if it's the same here or there, why wouldn't they want to stay where it's easier...
scripts.translation: 我不是特意想回去......只是人們來這裡是為了過上更好的生活。如果這裡和拉赫沒什麼兩樣，為什麼不留在生活更輕鬆的地方呢......

scripts.text: So what I'm saying is... I'm trying to figure it out. When did I say I would just cut it and go back? Can you please not listen to me however you want?
scripts.translation: 我的意思是......我還在想辦法。我什麼時候說過要放棄回去？能不能別自作主張地理解我的話？

scripts.text: Hmmm... but the clinic is a necessity as far as I'm concerned, and if I can make the case...
scripts.translation: 嗯......可在我看來，診所確實是必需的。如果能說服大家......

scripts.text: That's right! I think the adventurer might be able to help us out. You know, this adventurer is really good at talking, don't you think his face makes him believable? This is just the kind of prize that grown-ups like.
scripts.translation: 對了！冒險者也許能幫我們。你看，他很會說話，而且看起來就很可信，不是長輩們喜歡的那種人選嗎？

scripts.text: He has a big heart, and he helped us buy and transport supplies.
scripts.translation: 他心地善良，還幫我們採購和運送物資。

scripts.text: He's a nice guy. He's a good man, yes, but...
scripts.translation: 他是個好人，確實很好......可是......

scripts.text: ...Is that really the kind of person who gets the favor of the adults? They're so... so... stubborn.
scripts.translation: ......這樣的人真能得到長輩們的支援嗎？他們實在......太固執了。

scripts.text: You have to make the most of it. Even if I can't persuade you, what else is there to do but listen to more nagging? Is that the adventurer going to listen to that instead?
scripts.translation: 你得把握機會。就算我說不動他們，難道你要讓冒險者去聽那些嘮叨嗎？

scripts.text: Well... Can I ask you a favor?
Adventurer, do me a favor, we really need a modern clinic here, even if it's not as big as the one from Rachel.
scripts.translation: 你一件事嗎？冒險者，我們真的需要一間現代化診所，就算沒有拉赫那間那麼大也行。

scripts.text: Where I am now, if I get hurt or sick, I have to rely on folk remedies from the past.
scripts.translation: 我現在住的地方，受傷或生病時只能靠過去的民間療法。

scripts.text: I have some medicines and medical supplies from Rachel, but they are scarce, and I'm not in the right place to use them.
scripts.translation: 我從拉赫帶來了一些藥品和醫療用品，但數量有限，而且這裡也不適合使用。

scripts.text: But there's nothing I can do to convince the naysayers, so I'm going to ask an adventurer <NAVI>[sir]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to do it for me.
scripts.translation: 我實在說服不了反對的人，所以想請冒險者<NAVI>[先生]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>替我去說服他們。

scripts.text: Please do, and in the meantime, I'll go meet some other people.
scripts.translation: 拜託你了。我趁這段時間去見見其他人。

scripts.text: How about this? Don't push yourself for a while, eat good food, think good thoughts, and rest well, and you'll be able to walk or run lightly.
scripts.translation: 這樣吧，暫時別勉強自己，多吃點好東西、想些開心的事，好好休息，就能輕鬆走路甚至跑起來。

scripts.text: Am I alive?? Am I alive?? Is my leg okay??
scripts.translation: 我還活著嗎？？還活著嗎？？我的腿沒事吧？？

scripts.text: Uh, since you say it is, it must be, right?
scripts.translation: 呃，你說沒事，那應該就是沒事吧？
